panels.description: Share of fetcher queue requests that are retrying or exhausted.

targets.expr: ((sum by (job) (rate(mvcr_fetcher_requests_total{job=~"${fetcher_job:regex}",source=~"${source:regex}",request_type=~"${request_type:regex}",result=~"retry|failed"}[$__rate_interval]))) or (0 * sum by (job) (rate(mvcr_fetcher_requests_total{job=~"${fetcher_job:regex}",source=~"${source:regex}",request_type=~"${request_type:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))) / clamp_min(sum by (job) (rate(mvcr_fetcher_requests_total{job=~"${fetcher_job:regex}",source=~"${source:regex}",request_type=~"${request_type:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.001)

panels.description: Telegram notification outcomes. Dead users are expected product outcomes; delivery failures are retryable_gave_up and permanent_other.

targets.expr: sum by (notification_kind, result) (rate(mvcr_bot_notifications_total{namespace="$namespace",job="$bot_job"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() vector(0)

targets.expr: sum by (job, stage, error_type) (rate(mvcr_fetcher_errors_total{job=~"${fetcher_job:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) or label_replace(label_replace((0 * max by (job) (mvcr_fetcher_target_up{job=~"${fetcher_job:regex}"})) unless on (job) sum by (job) (rate(mvcr_fetcher_errors_total{job=~"${fetcher_job:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])), "stage", "no_errors", "job", ".*"), "error_type", "", "job", ".*")
